question: The value of 4{1over3} [7 {2over 3} - {4over3} ({25over 3} - {1over6} - {2over 3})]
solution:
**Given**

 

4{1over3} [7 {2over 3} - {4over3} ({25over 3} - {1over6} - {2over 3})]

 

**Concept**

BODMAS

 
 

 B
 Bracket, {,[,(
 
 

 O
 'OF'
 
 

 D
 Divsion, ÷ 
 
 

 M
 Multiply, × 
 
 

 A
 Addition, +
 
 

 S
 Subtraction, -
 
 

**Calculation**

 

⇒ 41over3[23over3 - 4over3 (50 - 1 - 4over6)

⇒ 13over3[23over3 - 4over3(45over6)]

⇒ 13over3[23over3 - 10]

⇒ (13/3) × (23 - 30over 3)

⇒ (13/3) × (-7over3)

⇒ (-91/9)

∴ The value of 4{1over3} [7 {2over 3} - {4over3} ({25over 3} - {1over6} - {2over 3})] is -91over9
